risks: The loss of any of these customers or reduction in business from such will have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
We are dependent on limited number of customers for majority of our revenue from operations, which expose us to a high risk of customer concentration.

The table below sets forth our revenue from our top one (1) customer, top three (3) customers, top five (5) customers and top ten (10) customers and their contribution to our revenue from operations for the periods indicated.
As on March 31, 2026, we had long-standing relationships of over five to seven years with several of our top ten customers.

Given the concentration of our business among a limited number of customers, any loss of, or reduction in business from, one or more such customers may have a disproportionate and material adverse effect on our revenues, profitability, cash flows and liquidity.

Such loss or reduction may arise for several reasons, including termination or non-renewal of contracts, inability to agree on commercial terms, failure to meet performance or customisation requirements, technological changes, disputes, adverse changes in the financial condition or business priorities of customers (including insolvency or financial distress), reduced or delayed demand, operational disruptions at customer level, or sustained pricing pressures.
Further, factors beyond our control, including changes in customer strategy, regulatory developments or a shift of business to competitors, may also result in loss of business.
There can be no assurance that our customers will continue to engage with us on existing or comparable terms or that we will be able to replace any lost business in a timely manner or at all.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: Through our association with Brunswick Bowling Products LLC, we provide comprehensive bowling solutions covering design and layout consultation, equipment supply, installation, commissioning, lane servicing, preventive and corrective maintenance, scoring systems integration, spare parts management and technical support for both traditional and duckpin bowling formats.

other_material_facts.value: Under our consultancy and management services vertical, we provide advisory and consulting services and undertake management contracts relating to the establishment and operation of entertainment facilities.

other_material_facts.label: distribution_network
other_material_facts.value: Our Company is the authorised distributor of Brunswick Bowling products LLC in India, Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia.

other_material_facts.label: distribution_network
other_material_facts.value: We entered into a distributorship agreement with Brunswick Bowling & Billiards Corporation for the territory of India on January 1, 2010, pursuant to which we were appointed as its authorised distributor in India.

other_material_facts.label: technology_ip
other_material_facts.value: Further, operators are increasingly adopting space-efficient formats, including multi-activity centres and compact attractions combining bowling, arcade gaming, trampoline parks, soft play areas and immersive gaming experiences, thereby facilitating the development of scalable and city-centric indoor amusement models. • Technology-Led Transformation of Indoor Entertainment: Technological advancements, particularly the increasing adoption of Virtual Reality (“VR”) and Augmented Reality (“AR”), are transforming the indoor amusement centre industry by enabling the delivery of immersive and interactive entertainment experiences.

other_material_facts.label: technology_ip
other_material_facts.value: Technology-driven attractions also support higher customer spending, increased repeat visitation and improved monetisation opportunities through premium experiences and bundled offerings.

other_material_facts.label: technology_ip
other_material_facts.value: The increasing adoption of technology-enabled entertainment formats is expected to support the long-term growth of organised indoor amusement centres and enhance the attractiveness of experiential leisure offerings. • Emergence of Integrated Multi-Entertainment Formats: According to the D&B Report, the indoor amusement centre industry in India is increasingly evolving towards integrated, multi-entertainment formats that combine gaming attractions with food and beverage offerings, social spaces and event-led entertainment.

other_material_facts.label: distribution_network
other_material_facts.value: Our Competitive Strengths We believe that the following are our primary competitive strengths: a) Exclusive distributorship for Brunswick Bowling products in India We are an authorised distributor of Brunswick Bowling Products LLC in India, Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia.

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: Our installation, commissioning and maintenance activities are primarily undertaken by our in-house technical team based in Mumbai, which is deployed to project locations, as required, for installation, testing, commissioning and servicing of equipment.

other_material_facts.label: vertical_integration
other_material_facts.value: We will continue to leverage our centralized procurement and project management capabilities and our in-house technical expertise to execute projects across geographies while maintaining appropriate quality and service standards.

other_material_facts.label: certifications
other_material_facts.value: Vendor Identification and Sourcing: Following finalisation of the proposed solution, we identify suitable manufacturers and vendors in India and overseas, as applicable, based on factors including product specifications, technical capabilities, quality standards, certifications, delivery schedules, commercial terms, warranty provisions and past performance.

other_material_facts.label: repeat_business
other_material_facts.value: Accordingly, repeat orders from the same customer may arise primarily in connection with expansion of existing facilities, refurbishment or modernisation of existing facilities, addition of new attractions or procurement of additional equipment.

other_material_facts.label: repeat_business
other_material_facts.value: We believe that our ability to provide customised solutions and support customers across various stages of the project lifecycle enables us to develop and maintain long-standing relationships with customers.

other_material_facts.label: repeat_business
other_material_facts.value: We have established long-standing relationships with several reputed manufacturers and suppliers of amusement and entertainment equipment, including Baohui, Coastal Amusements Inc., Elaut NV, Intercard Inc., Komuse America Inc., Bandai Namco and Sega.

other_material_facts.label: scale
other_material_facts.value: We believe that our existing infrastructure and facilities are adequate for our current scale of operations.

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- The loss of any of these customers or reduction in business from such will have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
- We are dependent on limited number of customers for majority of our revenue from operations, which expose us to a high risk of customer concentration.
- The table below sets forth our revenue from our top one (1) customer, top three (3) customers, top five (5) customers and top ten (10) customers and their contribution to our revenue from operations for the periods indicated.
- As on March 31, 2026, we had long-standing relationships of over five to seven years with several of our top ten customers.
- Given the concentration of our business among a limited number of customers, any loss of, or reduction in business from, one or more such customers may have a disproportionate and material adverse effect on our revenues, profitability, cash flows and liquidity.
- Such loss or reduction may arise for several reasons, including termination or non-renewal of contracts, inability to agree on commercial terms, failure to meet performance or customisation requirements, technological changes, disputes, adverse changes in the financial condition or business priorities of customers (including insolvency or financial distress), reduced or delayed demand, operational disruptions at customer level, or sustained pricing pressures.
- Further, factors beyond our control, including changes in customer strategy, regulatory developments or a shift of business to competitors, may also result in loss of business.
- There can be no assurance that our customers will continue to engage with us on existing or comparable terms or that we will be able to replace any lost business in a timely manner or at all.
